div.div: Db2 in Fabric is read-only. There is no write-back, no Mirroring and no CDC for Db2 — every option (Copy activity, Dataflow Gen2, Copy job) is source-only and every one of them goes through the gateway.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1830px; height: 1px; padding-top: 763px; margin-left: 14px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #5C5C5C;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#5C5C5C, #9e9e9e); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Incremental load is a watermark, not CDC. The demo uses the Db2 LUW ROW CHANGE TIMESTAMP: it catches inserts and in-place updates but not deletes. Reconcile periodically, or use IBM i journals with a replication product for Equation.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1830px; height: 1px; padding-top: 785px; margin-left: 14px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #5C5C5C;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#5C5C5C, #9e9e9e); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: Still to validate. Db2 LUW is the demo stand-in for Equation on Db2 for i — the medallion and everything right of it are identical, the connector and the change-capture mechanism are not. The data agent needs an F2+ capacity and a cross-geo AI processing sign-off.
